messages:
Evan M: Quick note 00: planning a partner-facing demo and blackbox test for the Orchestrator adapter + LangChain/LlamaIndex flows. Need checklist for demos, security signoff, and marketplace asset owners.

Priya S: +1. prefer to run demos on the dedicated canary cluster to avoid noisy prod metrics. who owns demo creds? :lock:

Diego R: we can generate short-lived demo tokens from the demo-service. I'll add a script to rotate them daily. Also, propose a tiny sample app that uses langchain chains -> our adapter so partners can smoke-test locally.

Hannah Q: For the marketplace: packaging needs screenshots, billing SKU mapping, and an audit log sample. Azure also wants compliance checklist PDF. We should align on branding guidelines with legal before co-badging.

Evan M: Good points. Proposed demo plan:
- Day A: internal blackbox run (3rd-party SI testers)
- Day B: partner-facing scheduled demos (2 partners)
- Day C: automated perf sweep on Ampere + A100 (latency, p95, token cost)
- Day D: finalize marketplace assets and legal check

Priya S: tech checklist for demo app:
```
- repo: demos/orchestrator-adapter-smoke
- deps: python langchain, llama-index, requests
- env: DEMO_TOKEN (rotated), ADAPTER_ENDPOINT
- run: python demo.py --flow retrieval-qa
```
Keep sample prompts small so token counts are deterministic.

Diego R: Blackbox test plan: 5000 short-queries (seq len <= 64) at 50 rps, validate responses for schema + random spot-check quality. Fail if more than 1% mismatches or >5% errors.

Hannah Q: Marketplace owners: AWS (Kira), GCP (Sanjay), Azure (Marta). I'll loop them in. Also need partner logo usage approval from Orchestrator legal.

Evan M: SI handoff note: include a runbook section with rollback toggle and traffic-split example. Minimal API snippet for customers to opt in:
```
curl -X POST $ADAPTER/admin/switch -d '{"target":"orchestrator","weight":20}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN"
```
Roll back if error rate > 3% over 10 minutes.

Priya S: Security asks: can we provide a read-only audit view for partners during demos? legal often asks for data isolation proof.

Diego R: yes, setup an isolated workspace with RBAC read-only tokens. I'll add RBAC template to the demo repo.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS listing requires final artifact upload 10 business days before publish window. See https://marketplace.aws/guide

Hannah Q: Comms: propose a joint webinar 1 week after listing goes live. Partner wants a technical deep-dive + live Q&A. We'll draft slides and a short partner case study snippet.

Evan M: Action items summary:
- Diego: demo token rotation script + RBAC template (due +2 days)
- Priya: demo app + deterministic prompts (due +3 days)
- Hannah: marketplace contacts + legal logo approval (due EOD)
- Evan: draft webinar agenda + perf success criteria (due +5 days)

Priya S: tagging eng-oncall for perf runs. also will open a tiny infra ticket for Ampere/A100 allocation.

Diego R: I'll push a PR with the blackbox harness and a results dashboard stub. Keep expectations low for initial run. :memo:

Evan M: Thanks all. I'll stitch this into the partnerships wiki and ping partners once legal confirms logo use.

marketplace-bot: Note: please attach compliance artifacts to the marketplace ticket by D-14 to avoid delays.
